none: PAS CAM-83B7B2: Roman Coin : Copper alloy Radiate Coin probably of Victorinus. Gaul Mint 1, AD269-271
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper alloy Radiate coin probably of Victorinus. Gaul Mint 1, AD269-271, (Reece period 13). Reverse legend reads FIDES [MILITVM]. Reverse shows Fides standing left with 2 Standards. See Cunetio p.148,c.f.2515. Obverse shows Radiate bust right ( ?portrait of Marius ). Condition shows some signs of wear. Die axis is 6 o'clock. Weight 2.78g, diameter 16.75mm
